messages:
Maya R: Quick sync 3: migrating /blog to /resources next Tue. Need a short SEO playbook for redirects + the webinar landing (schema + tracking).

Tom B: I can handle redirect CSV. Format: old,new,type,keep_queries. Will prefer 301s.

Leah S: I'll draft JSON-LD for the webinar (Event + FAQ) and add BreadcrumbList on hubs.

Tom B: Platform supports regex; will test on staging. Example rule Ill include: ^/blog/(\d{4})/([-\w]+)/?$ -> /resources/{2} .

ops-bot: Automated check: after deploy, run crawl; alert if >5% of top pages 4xx or >1 redirect hop.

Maya R: Checklist we need before flip:
- Redirect CSV in /ops/redirects/
- Canonicals updated to hub URLs
- Sitemap regenerated & Search Console pinged
- JSON-LD (Event+FAQ+Breadcrumb) on webinar/hub
- Internal links: product -> hubs, old posts -> hub
- GTM: webinar_reg event firing and HubSpot form mapping
- Staging crawl & Lighthouse SEO run

Leah S: FAQ items: "Will this replace old posts?" and "How do I get benchmark data?" I'll include answers in schema.

Tom B: I'll open PR with CSV and regex tests. Ping for edge-case slugs.

Maya R: Great. 15-min sync in 20 to assign final owners. :rocket:
